name: Streaks (bare-minimum)
pitch: A habit tracker. Tick off today's habits and watch the streaks grow.

baton.human: You review the screenshots, then deploy by hand

facts: 6 stages · 2 flows · 1 review stage · manual deploy

wip.how: Each stage shows wip used/limit. A flow never pulls a card into a full stage; the stage turns amber and the flow waits.
wip.why: AI can start work far faster than you can review it. Limits keep a few cards finishing instead of many half-done.
wip.here: Implement is full (2/2), so ST12 waits in Plan until you approve a card out of Review.

Implement.text: Full, so the implement flow isn't pulling anything new. ST12 waits in Plan.

Review.text: Its own stage, so cards waiting on you don't use the build stage's slots.

implement.blurb: a test loop on each task, a review, then screenshots for you
